title: Build agents2 one verified slice at a time
description: Plan for agents2, M0 to M6.

gate.work: Load a fixture package through a temporary PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR
gate.acceptance: Included extension loads; excluded extension does not; skill and prompt filters work

gate.work: Hash settings.json, check copies, swap the package symlink
gate.acceptance: Settings hash unchanged; no copies; Pi loads the new version

gate.work: ESM, Node >=22, strict TypeScript, oxlint, Vitest, check script, progress
gate.acceptance: Check passes; anti-slop rules reject a known-bad fixture; stop after M0

lifecycle.policy: Resolve by dependency kind; major bumps require --major
lifecycle.acceptance: Local npm registry fixture or file: tarballs

lifecycle.policy: One tool at a time; stop on first failure; retain earlier successes
Repoint retained version and restore the lock record

lifecycle.acceptance: Add then remove leaves both byte-identical

operations.work: Read-only PATH, shadowing, version, checksum and config-drift checks
operations.acceptance: Undeclared shadowing fails; doctor writes nothing

operations.work: Render launchd and systemd units; never start services
Render config, Mosaic, helpers and pinned plugins into a sandbox

parity.work: Read-only comparison of both profiles against active runtime configuration
Exercise add, remove, update, update-all and rollback
Fresh-machine, adopt, upgrade and profile guides
Write the cutover plan without executing it

risks.detail: The gate can force an install-layout change.
pi-extensions and pi-claude-code need GitHub auth on every machine.
The current curl installer needs a release or npm record.
Renderer files sit beside the CLI; retain the full extracted release tree.

props.content: Prove Pi can load local packages first. Everything else waits on that gate.

props.title: Milestones and acceptance
props.deck: Each claim shows how its parts connect, then what must pass.
props.takeaway: M0 gates everything: if Pi cannot load local packages, stop.

props.text: M0 proves local-path loading and scaffolds checks before implementation proceeds.

props.caption: Record the fixture evidence in docs/gate/pi-local-path.md and report to the supervisor after M0.

props.question: If the Pi local-path gate fails, what happens next?

options.label: Stop and report the gate result
options.consequence: Keep the M0 supervisor checkpoint before changing the layout.

options.label: Request an install-layout revision
options.consequence: The gate evidence must justify a new approved layout.

props.text: M1 separates the pure planner from the executor and makes unsafe filesystem targets fail.

props.caption: Schemas and canonical-path safety constrain effects before the executor can write.

props.text: M1 acceptance rejects home, ancestors, protected paths and symlink escapes.

props.content: **Acceptance:** home, ancestors, protected paths and symlink escapes are rejected.

props.text: M2 stages and verifies each tool before activating an immutable version directory.

props.caption: A crash must leave no partial version directory; rerunning a completed install is a no-op.

states.label: Verify
states.description: Exact version, checksum or content hash

states.label: Activate
states.description: Rename to tools/<id>/<version>; create bin links; retain N versions

events: + verified -activate-> active : atomic rename and bin links

props.question: Which managed dependency kind should replace OpenCode's curl installer?

options.label: npm record
options.consequence: Use the plan's exact-version npm staging path.

options.label: release record
options.consequence: Use the plan's SHA-256 verification and extraction path.

props.text: M2 installation tests preserve package identity and release layout.

props.content: **Acceptance:** a crash leaves no partial directory; a checksum mismatch leaves nothing.

props.text: M3 renders profile bundles, preserves unowned configuration and switches current atomically.

props.caption: Dry run remains the default, and only --yes executes the planned switch.
steps: + user -> apply : request profile dry run
+ apply -> adapters : render and merge unowned fields

props.text: M3 adapter checks exercise both profiles without changing tool directories.

props.content: **Acceptance:** both profiles apply into a temp root and restore replaced links.

props.text: M4 makes updates, rollback and tool membership changes testable end to end.

props.caption: Test failure and rollback behavior, not only successful installs.

props.text: M5 diagnoses drift read-only and renders services without starting them.

props.caption: Service units cover the gateway, OpenCode web, cloud worker, Clockwork and needed Herdr pieces.

props.text: M6 proves parity and documents cutover without executing it.

props.caption: Cutover requires supervisor sign-off after the parity and sandbox evidence.

props.text: Every slice closes accepted review findings before the next slice starts.

props.caption: Measure non-test and test TypeScript lines with scripts/size.sh at each milestone.

items.title: Implement
items.body: Lead drives; impl gathers evidence; check passes before focused commits.

items.title: Fresh-context review
items.body: A separate reviewer inspects the diff range and writes docs/reviews/<slice>.md.

items.title: Close findings
items.body: Lead decides; accepted findings are fixed before continuing.

props.title: Rules that govern every slice
props.deck: Two rules apply to every milestone below.

props.content:
- Test every write path against a temporary root; use no module mocks.
- Run `npm run check` green before each commit.

props.title: What to do and what to skip
props.deck: Work is ordered by when it earns its place.

rows.title: Prove the Pi local-path gate
